question: Poona Pact was between Mahatma Gandhi and __ __ .
solution:
The correct answer is** ' __Dr. B.R. Ambedka__r'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In 1932,** Mahatma Gandhi and Dr. B. R. Ambedkar** came to an agreement on behalf of Dalits, lower caste Hindu leaders, and the depressed classes on the reservation of seats for the depressed classes in the assembly of British India.
 
• This agreement is known as the** Poona Pact**.
 
• **Dalits **(low-caste Hindu groups at the time commonly referred to as "untouchables") were granted additional rights by the Poona Pact, an agreement between Hindu leaders in India, on September 24, 1932.
 
• B.R. Ambedkar and Mahatma Gandhi negotiated the Poona Pact in **1932**. The Communal Award of August 1932, which established a distinct electorate for oppressed classes, served as the impetus for the Poona Pact.
